blocks.text: Avaner Women's Bracelet Square Watches: Gold Silver Stainless Steel Strap Analog Quartz Elegant Wrist Watches

items.label: 【SIZE】Case Size
items.value: 32mm*23mm (1.3"*0.9"); Max Wearing Length: 220mm (8.7"); Band Width: 13mm; Case Thickness: 9mm; Weight: 49g.

items: 【FEATURES】Classic rectangular watch; Rhinestone decorated dial; Three-hand analog display; Scratch-resistant glass; Adjustable strap with link remover. The clean white dial features a simple and minimalist layout, with slim hour markers and hands that complement the overall elegant appearance.

【ADJUSTABLE】The adjustable strap fits most wrists, sturdy and comfortable to wear. Come with an extra battery and a watch link remover, allows you to change battery or adjust the band size easily. (You just need to line up the threaded push rod with the link pins, then rotate the handle to push the punch pin to extrude the band latch.)
【PRECISE TIME KEEPING】High quality Japanese quartz movement provides precise and accurate timekeeping. With this wristwatch, you will not miss any important meetings or dating.

【IDEAL CHOICE FOR HER】Whether paired with formal attire or casual outfits, this gold-tone watch can seamlessly complement a variety of styles, making it a versatile and stylish accessory for any occasion.
